home.intro: nodeFileView is an online file preview service. One amd64 image for both production and test: set PORT (8012 / 8013), put Nginx/BT Panel in front, then upload files or pass remote URLs to preview Word / Excel / PPT / PDF / images / Markdown / source / archives / media, with watermark, AES url encoding, console lock and host trust controls.
home.guideDesc: From Docker start → public domain → console login → generate /onlinePreview for your host app.
home.step1Desc: Use the same ghcr.io image. Production listens on 8012, test on 8013. PORT and -p right-hand side must match. Bind to 127.0.0.1 and expose via reverse proxy only.
home.step2Desc: Point a domain to this host. In BT Panel / Nginx, reverse-proxy / to http://127.0.0.1:8012 (prod) or :8013 (test). Enable SSL on the site.
home.step3Desc: Visit the domain, sign in with BASIC_AUTH_USER / BASIC_AUTH_PASS, then upload in File Storage or paste an https URL in the playground.
home.step4Desc: Encode the file URL as Base64 (or AES). Open or embed /onlinePreview with optional watermark, page, highlight and lang=.
home.deployDesc: Snippets below mirror this instance’s TRUST_HOST / NOT_TRUST_HOST. BASE_URL and data volume are optional. BASIC_AUTH_PASS uses a placeholder — replace with your real password.
home.deployCurrentDesc: Generated from the running server config. Change env and restart the container, then refresh this page.
home.deployProdDesc: Same trust settings as live; container listens on 8012.
home.deployTestDesc: Same trust settings as live; container listens on 8013 with a separate data volume.
home.deployEnvDesc: These control listen port, console lock, public base URL and remote-fetch allowlist.
home.deployEnvPort: Service listen port inside the container (8012 prod / 8013 test).
home.deployEnvPublish: Host:container publish. The container side MUST equal PORT, e.g. -p 127.0.0.1:8013:8013 with -e PORT=8013.
home.deployEnvAuth: Console Basic Auth. Keep BASIC_AUTH_PASS in the command; examples show a placeholder, not your real password.
home.deployEnvBase: Optional display-only public URL. Not required for preview; examples omit it.
home.deployEnvTrust: Remote preview host allowlist (supports *). Taken from current TRUST_HOST.
home.deployEnvNotTrust: Blocked hosts/CIDRs (supports *). Taken from current NOT_TRUST_HOST.
home.deployEnvData: Optional. Mount a host dir to /app/data to keep uploads/cache after recreate. Examples omit -v; data stays inside the container.
home.proxyDesc: Typical BT Panel / Nginx in front of Docker on the same machine.
home.proxyTip1: Proxy target must be http://127.0.0.1:8012 or :8013 — the port Docker published on the host.
home.proxyTip2: Verify on the server: curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:8013/ should return HTTP 200 before debugging the domain.
home.proxyTip3: docker ps Ports should show 127.0.0.1:8013->8013/tcp (or 8012). EXPOSE 8012 alone does not publish a port.
home.proxyTip4: Open firewall/security-group 80/443 for the site. Do not expose 8012/8013 to the public internet.
home.proxyCfWarn: Cloudflare tip: free Universal SSL covers *.example.com but NOT multi-level hosts like test.preview.example.com. Prefer preview-test.example.com, enable Total TLS / Advanced Certificate, or grey-cloud DNS and terminate SSL on origin.
home.formatsDesc: Formats optimized in phase 1. Other Office / WPS / ODF go through LibreOffice → PDF.
home.fmtWordDesc: docx native layout, outline and light editing; doc / wps / odt convert to PDF.
home.fmtExcelDesc: xlsx / xls / csv grid, light edit and export.
home.fmtPptPdfDesc: pptx slides; PDF paging, thumbnails and highlight.
home.fmtImageDesc: Zoom, rotate, flip; HEIC conversion supported.
home.fmtTextDesc: Markdown / source light edit and download export.
home.fmtArchiveDesc: zip / tar / gz directory tree and in-archive preview (remote zip supported).
home.apiDesc: Core entry for host apps and WebView. Build links in the playground first.
home.apiHint: url supports https://... or uploaded file://local/{fileId}. Add password when PREVIEW_PASSWORD is set. Use lang= for UI language.
home.securityDesc: Console lock (BASIC_AUTH_*), TRUST_HOST / NOT_TRUST_HOST, private IP block, upload allowlist, HTML/JS forced download. Prefer binding Docker to 127.0.0.1 only.
home.outDesc: No CAD / 3D / mail / ofd / epub specialists, no AV transcoding, no real FTP fetch yet.
